shared_elements: stylized rendering of a curved organic form
justification: A shows purely ornamental registers — a band of drooping leaf/petal forms, a zigzag frieze and a guilloche border — while B shows a bearded human head in profile with a fluted headdress and tightly spiralled curls; the only real overlap is that both are shallow relief with repeated stylized units arranged in bands (A's zigzag/leaf rows, B's fluted crown and rows of hair curls). There is no shared figural subject, no shared relationship between elements, and the vegetal/geometric ornament of A has no counterpart in B's naturalistic-but-conventionalized portrait head.
